title: A strength program with weight history
description: Follow the plan you chose, record the load you actually lifted, and discuss changes with a trainer.

blocks.text: Inside a chosen strength program it helps to check the exercise history quickly. This scenario differs from a plain log in that what you do is tied to the order of the sessions.

quote.text: I LOVE that the weight tracker is right on the screen for the workout now! I love being able to easily see my history quickly to adjust my weight if needed.

blocks.text: Link the program with what was actually done

Show where an exercise came from, keep the previous records beside it, and save today’s result separately from the plan. When an exercise is swapped, reflect that explicitly in the current session without rewriting the past.
Keep the chosen way of being in control

If a person trains with a trainer, let them prepare a clear history to discuss. If they train on their own, leave the editing in their hands. Having a history gives the app no grounds to prescribe a universal load on its own.
